idle AREA: Vacuum Pack: the selected meshes in one bag, the air sucked out
Pick Gather Point (click on the mesh)
draw a lasso on the mesh: a loose cloth over that region
Tack Pins (0): cloth point, then body point
Drape This Mesh (on the other selected / its tack pins)
Mask (as in the ZBRUSH screen: drag = mask · Alt = erase · X = mirror)
Ctrl + click empty = invert · Ctrl + lasso = mask · Ctrl + drag empty = clear
Drape Mask (masked faces lift off as the cloth)
Drape Mask: Fall Free (not held at the rim)
Wrap This Mesh (like a wrapping cloth)
Stitches on the cloth (0)   drag = a seam · Ctrl+Z = undo the last · Esc = done
